_help: Your overrides for the /wishlist page. Items are synced from Amazon automatically into data.json (do not edit that file).
Key each entry by the item's ASIN (the 10-character code in its amazon.com/dp/XXXXXXXXXX link).
priority: highest | high | medium | low | lowest. Overrides the priority set on Amazon; items with neither are medium.
rank: optional number; lower shows first within the same priority. note: optional text shown on the card (overrides the Amazon comment).
hide: true keeps an item off the page without removing it from Amazon.
